text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Listen closely, Suzuka-san!
What I'm about to say may sound veeeery harsh, but...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: This is the "long jump"!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: If you just run off from the approach, that's a disqualification!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I-I know that! But, before I know it...
Running just feels so fun...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
—Aha!
I just had a nice idea!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If running is fun...
then just run to your heart's content, and THEN leap!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
What?!
Isn't that just completely unreasonable...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! "Good Luck! Athlete Horoscopes" says
that when you're in a rush, taking the long way around is best!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Plus, with friends by your side, it's Great Blessing!
For Suzuka-san's sake... we'll come along too!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... Is this really okay, I wonder...?
I feel like I'm going to forget this was supposed to be for the long jump."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"No problem even if you forget!
We're right here with you♪"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! What a pleasant breeze...
Would you mind if we stayed like this just a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... be my guest, be my guest!
Onward to the lucky direction!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Phew... phew...!
We've come quite a long way, haven't we...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
How about... it's about time...!
Just one little hop, skip, and a jump...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
~~♪
Not yet... Even further—!

text_block_list.name: Taiki & Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...What? S-Suzuka...!?
...Huh? S-Suzuka-san...!?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... Such a wonderful view...
...Yeah... with this...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*... *wheeze*...
S-Suzuka-shaaan...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hey, both of you~! Right now, I—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: —Take this!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I did it...! I jumped it!
Thank you both so much for keeping me com—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... *gasp*... S-Something like this is...
nothing to me-desu...!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Fugh... If this... will make Suzuka-san
happy... then I'll...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It's Great Fortune... after all...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
T-Taiki? Fukukitaru...!?
Hang in there, pull yourselves together...!
